title: fix(showcase): a paid invoice's lines can no longer be added, removed or moved, so its total stays what was paid
body:
Fixes #24684

Clause-②: no (narrowing) (the showcase refuses two writes it accepted; if the measurement shows the platform half would relax a refusal a faulting rule makes today, the dev stops and reports before building it, and the seat re-declares)

Built under the seat ruling 6281609466 on #24684 (route C, so B now), after the dev's `needs_decision` 6281203874. No `objectql`, lint or spec change: the lint trap measured on the way is #24720.

## What changes

A paid invoice's lines are now locked against being **added, removed and moved**, not only edited, so its `total` stays what was paid.

- `readonlyWhen: parent.status == 'paid'` on a line's `product`, `quantity` and `unit_price` still locks **edits**. It is insert-exempt by design (#4889) and judges field values, not whether a line exists.
- Three lifecycle hooks on `showcase_invoice_line` (`examples/app-showcase/src/data/hooks/index.ts`) hold the rest. Each reads the header invoice under `runAs: 'system'` and refuses with a sentence:
  - `showcase_guard_paid_invoice_line_add` (beforeInsert): a new line under a paid invoice.
  - `showcase_guard_paid_invoice_line_move` (beforeUpdate, gated by `record.invoice != previous.invoice`): a line moved onto or off a paid invoice. The repoint was measured first and is admitted on `main` (below), so the ruling's guard is owed.
  - `showcase_guard_paid_invoice_line_remove` (beforeDelete): a line removed from a paid invoice, by id or by a bulk predicate.
- Two kinds of write pass every guard:
  - a **system write** (`session.isSystem`), because the seed loads INV-1003's line under a header that is already paid. The platform's static `readonly` strip exempts system writes the same way (`readonlyWhen` exempts no one). The exemption is every system writer, not only the seed: a script action's `ctx.api` and a `runAs: 'system'` flow pass too. None of them writes `showcase_invoice_line` in the showcase today.
  - a **cascade delete** (`ctx.referentialCascadeDelete`), because that is the header itself being deleted, not a line removed from a header that stays.
- `invoice.object.ts`'s `product` comment now says where each lock lives. The `amount` comment PR #24673 edited is untouched; that PR landed first and is merged in.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` `records-forms.object-hook-lifecycle`, rev 7: fixture roster only, no clause moved. Three stated facts the new hooks made false ("the five seeded showcase hooks", "beforeDelete has NO seeded showcase hook", "the one seeded hook that throws") now name them. This file is outside the claim's file surface; it is here because the change made its text false.

Why hooks, not a `validations[]` rule: measured on `main`, no `validations[]` rule binds `parent` on any write. A rule reading `parent.status` faulted `Unknown variable: parent` and refused every insert and update, the draft header's and the seed's included. And `validations[]` never runs on delete. `ValidationRuleSchema.events` prescribes lifecycle hooks for that case.

## Verification record

**Measured on a booted showcase (`pnpm dev -- --fresh -p PORT`, seeded admin).**

Before, at `main` 8e14ce0574 and 54159fd742:

| write | under paid INV-1003 | total |
|---|---|---|
| POST a line | 201 | 299.94 to 306.94 |
| DELETE its line | 200 | 306.94 to 7 |
| PATCH a draft line's `invoice` to INV-1003 | 200 | 299.94 to 749.94 |
| PATCH INV-1003's line `invoice` to a draft | 200 | 749.94 to 450 |

After, at this head `0aa9da1b3`:

| write | answer | total |
|---|---|---|
| POST a line under INV-1003 | 400, `error`: "This invoice is paid, so its lines are locked: a line cannot be added to it." | 299.94, unchanged |
| DELETE INV-1003's line | 400, "...a line cannot be removed from it." | 299.94, unchanged |
| PATCH a line onto INV-1003 | 400, "A paid invoice's lines are locked: a line cannot be moved onto or off a paid invoice." | both totals unchanged |
| PATCH INV-1003's line off it | 400, the same sentence | both totals unchanged |
| PATCH `quantity` on INV-1003's line | 200, dropped by `readonlyWhen` as before | 299.94, unchanged |
| draft INV-1004: POST, PATCH, DELETE | 201, 200, 200 | rolls up as before |

The boot logs no ERROR line: the seed's paid line still loads.

**Pins.** `examples/app-showcase/test/paid-invoice-line-lock.test.ts`, 12 tests, on the production harness the reopen-guard pin uses (real `ObjectQL`, `SqlDriver`, `QuickJSScriptRunner`, the app's real objects and hooks).
- Each refusal asserts a `SandboxError` whose `innerMessage` is the exact sentence (the field the `/data` door serves as the 400 above), plus the invoice's line count and `total` read back unchanged.
- Covered: insert, by-id delete, bulk delete, move onto and move off a paid header, and a paid header's own cascade delete.
- The draft control covers insert, delete, a move between drafts and a plain edit.
- A REVERSE case shows that with the hooks unbound the same writes land.

**Ablation.** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the three hooks from `allHooks` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `eeb196a2115d` to `fb951071b9d5`).
- Mutated: 5 failed, the five paid-header pins; 7 passed, the draft controls, the fixture, the cascade and the REVERSE case.
- Restored: blob `eeb196a2115d`, equal to `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` empty.

**Local runs.**
- After merging `origin/main` d20bf9b0: rebuilt with `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs --concurrency=2`, 76/76.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --listFiles` includes the new test and the hook module.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test`: 37 files, 443 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo`: 6 files, 82 tests passed.
- `os validate` (showcase): exit 0.

**Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths, at `0aa9da1b3`: 58 derived lines, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all exit 0.
- `--ran` answers: "58 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 58 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 58 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- Families CI owns (Test Core, Build Core, the type-check lanes) are read from this PR's check runs.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/24684-showcase-paid-invoice-line-lock.md`: `'@objectstack/example-showcase': patch`.
- Examples do not publish: the package is `private: true`. It is still versioned (`privatePackages.version: true`), and showcase-only fixes carry a `patch` changeset by precedent.
- `check-changeset-no-major` passes the level axis on the declared `no (narrowing)`.
- `check-adr-0087-registration` passes with `not-required (unpublished)`.

## Acceptance notes

- A sandboxed hook's business refusal reaches `/data` as `400` with the sentence in `error` and no `code` field. That is the platform's mapping for every hook refusal, the reopen guard's too. These hooks throw a plain sentence, the showcase's established shape, so no error code is invented here.
- A scratch curl cookie jar from my own measurement (a session cookie for an already-killed `--fresh` localhost server, so a dead credential) was committed in 6b269992 and removed in 0aa9da1b. A history rewrite was not done.
